messages:
Zoe: Quick sync — AtlasBank POC kicks off tomorrow 09:00 UTC. They need a one-pager: reserved GPU sizing, autoscale behavior for short 2-8m spikes, preheat expectations, and license clarity for quantized variants.
Harpreet: Traffic sketch?
Zoe: SRE stated steady 120 qps embeddings + 40 qps gen, two daily spikes to ~900 qps lasting 2-8 minutes. Targets: 95p embed <=140ms, gen <=260ms. Business hours SLA weekdays.
Diego: Ballpark reserved: steady + 30% headroom -> 3 reserved GPUs. Autoscale cap to 6 with burst credits. Recommend AZ spread 2+1, but 2+2 for full failover.
Mina: Preheat runbook (short for questionnaire): schedule 30m before peak; KV replay at 25% for 5m; synthetic soak at 50% for 5m; verify KV hit-rate >= 85%; fallback to burst credits if check fails.
Harpreet: Licensing: quantized runtime included in infra fee; legal prefers explicit contract line — we will provide.
Diego: Autoscale snippet they can paste: ```json
{"autoscale":{"min_reserved_gpus":3,"max_gpus":6,"scale_step":1,"cooldown_s":180,"preheat_window_mins":30,"burst_mode":"enabled","burst_qps_cap":1200}}
```
Mina: Observability checklist for their security form: per-route token counts, 95/99/99.9 pcts, KV hit-rate, preheat job logs, audit trail of preheat triggers — all surfaced in Console and API. Metrics aggregated; PII redacted.
ops-bot: Reminder: maintenance window tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC — schedule preheat outside this window. :warning:
Zoe: Action items — I'll draft the one-pager (sizing rationale + autoscale snippet + preheat runbook + pricing bullets + license line). Harpreet add pricing numbers, Mina update questionnaire text, Diego attach KV warmup script. Aim to send within 2 hours. :rocket:
